searchText: I suppose it will still be an EIP - Standard Track (ERC) and will be reviewed by EIP editors who are open to review ERC category proposals. However, we are looking to increase the number of qualified reviewers who maybe able to help us with reviewing ERC proposals.

excerpts.author: poojaranjan
excerpts.content: I suppose it will still be an EIP - Standard Track (ERC) and will be reviewed by EIP editors who are open to review ERC category proposals. However, we are looking to increase the number of qualified reviewers who maybe able to help us with reviewing ERC proposals.
